description: This file implements a peer endpoint lease management system for Kubernetes API servers, including lease creation, updating, listing, and removal, as well as a controller to periodically reconcile and update peer endpoint leases.

classes.name: PeerAdvertiseAddress
classes.description: Struct holding the peer advertise IP and port.

classes.name: peerEndpointLeases
classes.description: Struct managing storage and lease timing for peer endpoint leases.

classes.name: peerEndpointLeaseReconciler
classes.description: Implementation of the PeerEndpointLeaseReconciler interface, managing lease updates and retrieval.

classes.name: PeerEndpointLeaseController
classes.description: Controller managing periodic reconciliation and lease updates for peer endpoints.

methods.name: NewPeerEndpointLeaseReconciler
methods.description: Creates a new peer endpoint lease reconciler with specified storage config, base key, and lease duration.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Constructs a new PeerEndpointLeaseController with server ID, peer address, reconciler, interval, and Kubernetes client.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the peer endpoint lease reconciliation loop.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Periodically updates peer endpoint leases, waiting for the API server to be ready.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the peer endpoint lease reconciler and cleans up leases.

methods.name: UpdatePeerEndpointLeases
methods.description: Updates the lease for this server's peer endpoint, creating or refreshing the lease in storage.

methods.name: UpdateLease
methods.description: Resets the TTL on a server IP lease in storage, creating or updating the lease object.

methods.name: ListLeases
methods.description: Retrieves a list of current server IPs from storage.

methods.name: GetLease
methods.description: Retrieves the server IP and port for a specific server ID.

methods.name: RemoveLease
methods.description: Removes the lease object for a given server ID from storage.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with the lease.

methods.name: GetEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieves the endpoint address for a given server ID.

methods.name: StopReconciling
methods.description: Flags the reconciler to stop processing further updates.
